rollout; unavailable notices produce no banner.

upstream; whitespace checks pass. Exact-backport CI and production build
validation are pending.

## What changed

- Remove `stdout`, `stderr`, and `formatted_output` from `CommandExecutionItem` and `ExecCommandEndEvent`, retaining `aggregated_output` as the output field.
